recommended_parameters.type_1_to_2: Fluence 14-18 J/cm², Pulse Width 20-30ms, Spot Size 12mm
recommended_parameters.type_3_to_4: Fluence 12-14 J/cm², Pulse Width 30-40ms, Spot Size 10-12mm
recommended_parameters.type_5_to_6: Nd:YAG 1064nm only, Fluence 10-12 J/cm², Pulse Width 40-50ms

clinical_protocols.intervals: 4 to 6 weeks between sessions. Total course: 6 to 8 sessions.
contraindications: Current oral Isotretinoin (Roaccutane) use within past 6 months
Active tan, sunburn, or recent solarium exposure
Active herpes simplex or open skin infections in treatment area
clinical_protocols.pre_care: Shave treatment area 24 hours prior. Do NOT wax, pluck, or thread. Avoid sun exposure for 14 days.
clinical_protocols.post_care: Apply cold compress / Aloe vera gel for erythema. Mandate mineral Sunscreen SPF 50+ every 3 hours. Avoid hot showers, saunas, and steam for 48 hours.
clinical_protocols.roman_urdu_summary: Laser session se 24 ghantay pehle shaving lazmi hai. Waxing ya threading bilkul na karein. Treatment ke baad 48 ghantay garam pani se gurez karein aur har 3 ghantay baad SPF 50 sunblock lagayein.

step_by_step: Step 1: Cleanse + Vortex Exfoliation (Activ-4 Glucosamine serum)
Step 2: GlySal Peel (7.5% Glycolic + 2% Salicylic Acid for pore decongestion)
Step 3: Painless Vortex Suction Extraction (Beta-HD salicylic acid)
Step 4: Antioxidant + Hyaluronic Acid Infusion (Antiox+ serum with red/blue LED light therapy)
clinical_protocols.intervals: Every 3 to 4 weeks for maintenance. Bridal packages recommended 7-10 days before the wedding event.
contraindications: Active severe cystic acne flare-up with open pustules
Active facial eczema, psoriasis, or contact dermatitis
Shellfish / aspirin allergy (if using specific salicylic formulas)
clinical_protocols.pre_care: Discontinue topical retinoids, AHA/BHA exfoliants 3 days prior.
clinical_protocols.post_care: No makeup for 12 hours. Keep skin hydrated with barrier repair cream. Mandatory sunscreen application.
clinical_protocols.roman_urdu_summary: HydraFacial ke baad 12 ghantay tak makeup na lagayein. Skin ko hydrate rakhein aur dhoop mein nikalte waqt sunblock ka istemal karein.

clinical_protocols.recommended_parameters: Short-pulsed mode (Spectra mode) for carbon warm-up, followed by Q-switched mode (Fluence 1.8 - 2.4 J/cm², Spot Size 7-8mm) to vaporize carbon.
clinical_protocols.post_care: Mild erythema fades within 1-2 hours. Apply soothing sheet mask. Strict sun avoidance for 7 days.
clinical_protocols.roman_urdu_summary: Carbon peel pore size kam karne aur skin glow ke liye behtareen hai. Procedure ke baad halki surkhi 1-2 ghantay mein khatam ho jati hai.

clinical_protocols.reconstitution: 100 Units vial reconstituted with 2.5ml sterile preservative-free 0.9% saline.
contraindications: Allergy to botulinum toxin or human albumin
clinical_protocols.post_care: Keep head upright for 4 hours. No intense exercise, gym, or massaging face for 24 hours. Full onset in 7-14 days.
clinical_protocols.roman_urdu_summary: Botox ke baad 4 ghantay tak seedha baithein, jhukne ya laytne se gurez karein. 24 ghantay tak chehre par massage ya sakht exercise na karein.

clinical_protocols.treatment: Chemical Peels (Salicylic Acid 20%, Glycolic Acid 35%, TCA 15%)
clinical_protocols.neutralization: Monitor frosting / erythema. Neutralize with Sodium Bicarbonate buffer at 3-5 minutes or immediately if uneven frosting appears.
contraindications: History of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation without prepping
clinical_protocols.post_care: Do NOT pick or peel flaking skin. Generously apply ceramides and physical sunscreen.
clinical_protocols.roman_urdu_summary: Peeling ke baad skin utarne lage to hath se na kheenchein. Barrier cream lagayein aur direct dhoop se bachein.

faq_knowledge.question: Can I do laser hair removal if I am taking Roaccutane (Isotretinoin)?
faq_knowledge.answer: No. Patients on oral Isotretinoin must pause treatment and wait at least 6 months after completing their course before undergoing laser hair removal or ablative peels due to impaired wound healing and risk of scarring.

faq_knowledge.question: Kitne din baad HydraFacial ke results nazar aate hain?
faq_knowledge.answer: HydraFacial ka glowing result foran (same day) nazar aata hai aur 2-4 haftay tak barkarar rehta hai. Behtareen nataij ke liye monthly session recommended hai.

faq_knowledge.question: What should I do if a patient experiences excessive erythema after laser?
faq_knowledge.answer: Apply immediate cold ice packs or hydrogel cooling pads for 15 minutes. Apply 1% Hydrocortisone cream or Calamine/Aloe Vera lotion. Mandate zero sun exposure and monitor over 24 hours.
